fields.name: title
fields.label: Internal name
fields.description: More than one home page may exist. Only the one chosen in Settings is live, so a replacement can be built in full and switched over by changing a single setting. Name this one so you can tell them apart — staff see this name, visitors never do.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: The large heading at the top of the home page. A few words — it is the first thing a visitor reads.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro sentence
fields.description: One sentence under the headline. Leave blank to show the headline alone.

fields.name: promoRows
fields.label: Promotion rows on this page
fields.description: List every row, top to bottom — for one full-width row then two halves, add two rows: "1 across — full width", then "2 across — halves". These replace the rows in Site Settings for this page; leave empty to use those instead. Up to 6 rows. Promotions fill them by "Order", and a row with nothing running does not show.

fields.name: noindex
fields.label: Hide from Google
fields.description: Keeps the page reachable by its link but out of search results. Leave off unless you know you want this.

fields.name: noBackdrop
fields.label: Turn off the background watermark on this page

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Small line above the headline
fields.description: Two or three words, optional. For example: "This week only".

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: 28 characters or fewer — short headlines read best at every size. This is also the name you will see in the list of promotions.

fields.name: cta
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Leave blank for "Learn more". It shows in capitals on the button.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Picture
fields.description: One wide image, 2400 by 1350 or larger. The site crops it to fit wherever it appears.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the picture
fields.description: One short sentence, for people using a screen reader.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.label: Starts (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: A date like 10/03/2026, or a date and time like 10/03/2026 6:00 AM. Pacific time. Leave blank to start straight away.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.label: Ends (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: A date like 10/05/2026 runs to the end of that day; a date and time like 10/05/2026 12:00 PM stops at that minute. Pacific time. It comes down on its own. Leave blank to run until you turn it off.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Running
fields.description: On unless you turn it off. Off pulls the promotion immediately, whatever the dates say; turning it back on (and moving the end date if it has passed) brings it and its offer page back.

fields.name: pages
fields.label: Which pages
fields.description: Only used when "Specific pages only" is chosen above. Add one row per page — a general page or another offer page. Locations go in "Which locations", below.

fields.name: page
fields.label: Page
fields.description: Pick the page this promotion should appear on.

fields.name: locations
fields.label: Which locations
fields.description: Only used when "Specific pages only" is chosen above. Add one row per location page this promotion should appear on.

fields.name: priority
fields.label: Order (1 = first place)
fields.description: Which place it takes. Places fill top to bottom, left to right: with one full-width row and then two halves, 1 is the full-width row, 2 is the left half, 3 the right half. Leave blank to go after every numbered one. If more are running than there are places, the highest numbers wait and appear as others end. Promotion Status shows where each one is.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page title
fields.description: This is the page a promotion links to. When its promotion stops running the page keeps its web address but drops out of Google and says the offer has ended. Never delete one — shared links would break and the offer could not be brought back.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Leave blank for "Where to find us". The Truck Stop gets its own card: it has its own phone and its own hours.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: Set once when the location was created. Changing it breaks the web address and every link to it.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Full name
fields.description: The complete name, as it appears at the top of the location page. For example: Lummi Bay Market at Exit 260.

fields.name: navLabel
fields.label: Short name (menus and cards)
fields.description: Two or three words. For example: Exit 260.

fields.name: shortLabel
fields.label: Shortest name (fuel price table)
fields.description: The tightest version, used only where space is very tight. Fisherman’s Cove becomes "The Cove" here. Leave blank if the short name already fits.

fields.name: aka
fields.label: Also known as
fields.description: Any older or local name people still use.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone number
fields.description: The store’s number. At Exit 260 this is the C-Store line — the Truck Stop has its own, further down.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours
fields.description: The normal opening hours, short form: "6am–9pm", or "Open 24 hours". Keep it short — it has to fit on one line on a phone.

fields.name: hoursOverrides
fields.label: Temporary hours (holidays, closures)
fields.description: Usually empty. Use this for a short-term change — New Year’s Eve, a storm, a remodel. Type it weeks ahead: it starts and stops on its own, in Pacific time. For a permanent change, edit the Hours field above instead.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours during this period
fields.description: Short form, like "6am–4pm" or "Closed". This replaces the normal hours everywhere they appear.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason (two or three words)
fields.description: Shown on the location page only, never on the short cards. For example: "Christmas Day".

fields.name: startsAt
fields.label: First day (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: The first whole day these hours apply, Pacific time. For example 12/24/2026.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.label: Last day (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: The last whole day these hours apply, Pacific time, for example 12/26/2026. Required — without an end date the temporary hours would never go away on their own.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: One or two sentences about this place
fields.description: What makes this stop different, in a customer’s words. Shown on the contact page under the name. Leave it blank rather than writing something vague — the section simply omits it.

fields.name: cardLine
fields.label: One-line summary (street, then hours)
fields.description: What shows under the name on the short cards, for example "4839 Rural Ave · Open 24 hours". It is one line and it cuts off rather than wrapping, so keep it tight.

fields.name: amenities
fields.label: What’s here
fields.description: One thing per line — "Car wash", "Propane", "Hot food". Put the reason someone would stop first. Two or more are needed for the badges to show. Do not combine two things in one line.

fields.name: truckStop
fields.label: Truck Stop (Exit 260 only)
fields.description: The Truck Stop is a separate fuel station for truckers sharing the Exit 260 property — not a service of the store. Its phone, hours and amenities are its own and are never mixed with the store’s. Leave this empty at the other two locations.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Truck Stop phone number
fields.description: A driver asking about showers or the diesel lanes should reach the truck side, not the store.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: One or two sentences about the Truck Stop
fields.description: Shown on the contact page, where the Truck Stop is listed on its own.

fields.name: amenities
fields.label: What’s at the Truck Stop
fields.description: One per line: diesel lanes, DEF, showers, driver lounge, truck parking.

fields.name: hoursOverrides
fields.label: Temporary Truck Stop hours
fields.description: Usually empty. Use this for a short-term change — New Year’s Eve, a storm, a remodel. Type it weeks ahead: it starts and stops on its own, in Pacific time. For a permanent change, edit the Hours field above instead.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours during this period
fields.description: Short form, like "6am–4pm" or "Closed". This replaces the normal hours everywhere they appear.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason (two or three words)
fields.description: Shown on the location page only, never on the short cards. For example: "Christmas Day".

fields.name: startsAt
fields.label: First day (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: The first whole day these hours apply, Pacific time. For example 12/24/2026.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.label: Last day (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: The last whole day these hours apply, Pacific time, for example 12/26/2026. Required — without an end date the temporary hours would never go away on their own.

fields.name: hero
fields.label: Main photo
fields.description: Shown wide at the top of this location’s page, and on its card wherever the location cards appear (Home, the Locations page, the other location pages). Leave empty for no photo.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Photo
fields.description: One landscape photo, 2400 by 1350 or larger, with the storefront in the middle. The page shows a wide strip of it, the card most of it, and a phone a small square from the centre.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo
fields.description: One short sentence, for people using a screen reader.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Business name
fields.description: An independent business at one of our properties — they run themselves, we simply point to them. The page is called "Also at Exit 260". Nothing appears on the site until at least one business is published.

fields.name: placement
fields.label: Where on the property
fields.description: Used to group the cards, so a visitor knows where to walk.

options.label: Its own building on the property

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours
fields.description: Their hours, not ours. Leave blank if you are not sure.

fields.name: hoursConfirmed
fields.label: Hours confirmed with the business
fields.description: Hours are only shown once this is ticked. Posting a guess sends people to a closed door.

options.label: A page here on our site

fields.name: externalUrl
fields.label: Their website
fields.description: Only used when the card goes straight to their own website. The card is marked as leaving our site.

fields.name: markApproved
fields.label: We have permission to use their logo and photo
fields.description: The logo and photo stay hidden until this is ticked. Somebody else’s trademark is not ours to publish.

fields.description: Leave blank for "Where to find us". The Truck Stop gets its own card: it has its own phone and its own hours.

fields.name: alerts
fields.label: Notices (the bar across the top of every page)
fields.description: For something every visitor needs to see — a closure, a road out, a power cut, or an event weekend planned ahead. Add as many as you like. Each can start and end on its own; with no dates it shows as soon as it is switched on and stays until it is switched off. The bar holds one notice: if more than one is showing at the same time, the one highest in this list shows — drag them to change the order. For holiday hours use "Temporary hours" on the location instead.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Show this notice
fields.description: Off takes it down straight away, whatever the dates say. When nothing is showing the bar disappears completely — it leaves no gap behind.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: The main message
fields.description: One short sentence. For example: "The Minimart is closed today."

fields.name: detail
fields.label: Extra detail
fields.description: Optional second sentence.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link (optional)
fields.description: A page on this site with more information.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.label: Starts (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: A date like 10/03/2026, or a date and time like 10/03/2026 6:00 AM. Pacific time. Leave blank to show it as soon as it is switched on.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.label: Ends (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: A date like 10/05/2026 runs to the end of that day; a date and time like 10/05/2026 9:00 PM comes down at that minute. Pacific time. Leave blank to show it until it is switched off.

fields.name: updated
fields.label: Last updated (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.description: For example 10/05/2026.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Links in the four columns
fields.description: Every link in the About, Visit, Rewards and Work with us columns, in the order shown. Drag to reorder, delete a row to remove a link. A column with no links is not shown — except Visit, which then lists the locations automatically. Do not name Silver Reef, Loomis Trail, Salish Village or any other Lummi business in the link text: other Lummi companies appear on this site only as the one "Lummi Commercial Companies" link, and a link that names one will not be shown.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.description: What visitors read, for example: Gift cards.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Where it goes
fields.description: A page on this site starting with / (for example /rewards), or a full address starting with https://, mailto: or tel:. Outside addresses open in a new tab.

fields.name: privacyLabel
fields.label: Privacy Policy link — text
fields.description: Leave blank for "Privacy Policy". This link is always in the bottom row and cannot be removed.

fields.name: privacyUrl
fields.label: Privacy Policy link — where it goes
fields.description: Leave blank for /privacy. Changing this moves the link, not the policy page: the page stays at /privacy because both app stores link to it.

fields.name: lummiCommercialCompaniesUrl
fields.label: Lummi Commercial Companies link — where it goes
fields.description: The bottom row link to the wider group of companies. Its text cannot be changed: it is the one place on this site that names them.

fields.name: social
fields.label: Social accounts
fields.description: Links only — a link, never an embedded feed or follow button. Embedded widgets load code from the social network and set cookies before anyone clicks, which would make the privacy policy’s "this site sets no cookies" untrue. Leave the list empty and the row does not appear at all.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Name for screen readers
fields.description: For example: Facebook.

fields.name: embedCode
fields.label: Map embed code
fields.description: The map does not load until a visitor asks for it, so the page sets no cookies on arrival.

fields.name: stillImage
fields.label: Still picture shown before the map loads

fields.name: backdrop
fields.label: Background watermark
fields.description: A large faint image down one side of the page on desktop. Never shown on phones.

fields.name: opacity
fields.label: How faint (percent)
fields.description: 10 is the tested setting. Higher numbers start to compete with the text.

fields.name: headerMotifs
fields.label: Header motifs
fields.description: The row of motifs in the navy header, between the menu and the Get the App button. Keep as many groups as you like; switch on "Use this group in the header" for the one to show.

fields.name: groups
fields.label: Motif groups
fields.description: Each group is a set of motifs in order, with its own strength, scale, spacing and ink. Add a group with +, open one to edit it (the preview updates as you go), delete one with the bin.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Group name
fields.description: So you can tell groups apart, for example "Winter — orca, salmon, eagle". The preview updates as you change the settings below; turn on "Use this group in the header" at the bottom to show it.

fields.name: motifs
fields.label: Motifs, in order
fields.description: Shown left to right. Add each motif as its own row — an owl, a whale, a fish — or one file that already holds several. Drag to reorder. Where the band is too narrow for all of them, the last ones are left off rather than cut in half.

fields.name: file
fields.label: Motif file
fields.description: An SVG of plain shapes on a transparent background. Its colours are ignored — the band paints every motif in the ink chosen below. Each file is checked before it is uploaded.

fields.name: strength
fields.label: Strength
fields.description: How strongly the motifs show against the navy header, 0–40%. The approved look is 14%.

fields.name: scale
fields.label: Scale
fields.description: Motif height, as a share of the header bar, 40–100%. Bigger motifs mean fewer fit.

fields.name: spacing
fields.label: Spacing
fields.description: The gap between motifs, 0–64 pixels.

fields.name: ink
fields.label: Ink
fields.description: The one colour every motif is drawn in. Only brand colours are offered.

fields.name: repeat
fields.label: Repeat the group to fill the band
fields.description: On: the motifs repeat in order across the band. Off: each is shown once.

fields.name: live
fields.label: Use this group in the header
fields.description: Turn on for the group you want shown. If more than one is on, the first in the list is used.

fields.name: liveMainPage
fields.label: Which home page is live
fields.description: Only the version chosen here is shown to visitors.

fields.name: promoRows
fields.label: Promotion rows
fields.description: How promotions are laid out on every page that does not set its own rows. Each row holds one to four across; up to 6 rows. Promotions fill the rows in order, a row with nothing running does not show, and a row that loses one re-divides so there is never a gap. Leave empty for one full-width row, then two halves.
